title: BSnake
oneliner: Snake, but with teeth — dodge bosses, hoard healing fruit, outgrow friends on LAN. Android (Java, no libraries).
body: Two modes: Arcade (bosses + progression) and Classic (pure snake) on a toroidal grid with swipe controls and a 2-item input queue. Boss system: CHASER, WALL_BUILDER (destructible walls, destroyable by surrounding them in a closed loop), HEALER, and MIRROR (eating its fruit flips your controls for 5s). Every Arcade run starts with 3 random challenges from a pool of 20; top-20 leaderboard; LAN multiplayer with host/client discovery; in-app update checker. Everything drawn with Canvas shapes, all audio synthesized (Markov-chain menu music) — zero external assets.

title: Mineflayer Companion (Billy)
oneliner: Follow/guard companion + area-select automine + survival upkeep for MC 1.21.9.
body: Node bot (mineflayer + pathfinder + collectblock + pvp + armor-manager + auto-eat + tool). Chat commands with ! prefix or by name, typo suggestions, queued jobs, stuck protection with honest reports, selection-based mining/quarry/chop/farm/lightup, chest labels, waypoints, persistence across restarts. Streams a first-person browser view with selection + path overlay; control page on a second port.
note: Repo is private for now — no public link yet.
